public_health_question.v: Is toxigenic Corynebacterium ulcerans transmitted between humans and household pets, and how should infections be treated and controlled?

ev.q: Investigations in Utah and Colorado provide evidence of the risk for C. ulcerans transmission between humans and household pets.
Toxigenic Corynebacterium ulcerans in Humans and Household Pets — Utah and Colorado, 2022–2023
These Utah and Colorado cases represent the first reported U.S. cases of toxigenic C . ulcerans infection among humans with concurrent household pet colonization
Health officials in Utah and Colorado investigated these infections in humans and their household pets.

equity.level_reason: Two household case investigations; no social-position dimension is reported or compared.

notes: Two index cases with household contact testing; culture, PCR, Elek assay, WGS and susceptibility testing confirm case status or guide treatment and are not procedures. Design inferred as case report/series; it could also be read as two small outbreak investigations.
